# Motion export formats

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `vector`
- Slug: `vector/export`

## Summary

What Motion exports, all made in the browser: static and animated SVG, Lottie, code (React, JS/TS, Flutter) and raster video/GIF.

## Details

- Static SVG: the frame at the playhead, free and never counted.
- Animated SVG (`svg_animated`): pure CSS when possible, otherwise a small inline anime.js runtime.
- Lottie JSON (`lottie`): for apps and the web (LottieFiles); some effects do not carry over and are listed after export.
- React component (`react_tsx`), JavaScript or TypeScript module (`js_ts`), Flutter widget (`flutter`).
- GIF (`gif`), PNG sequence (`png_sequence`), MP4 (`mp4`) and WebM (`webm`), encoded in the browser.
Counted formats: svg_animated, lottie, react_tsx, js_ts, flutter, gif, png_sequence, mp4, webm. Which formats each plan includes and its daily allowance of animated exports are live numbers (quote only from the live plan block).
By destination: website hero → animated SVG or Lottie; app → Lottie or React/Flutter; social post → MP4; chat/README → GIF.
